title: 1 year and counting:
author: Front-Pay3056
selftext: Hello my name is Tunacan2EZ this has been my gamer name for 25 years I been playing games maybe 30 years. I'm one of the first people to join the world's first native AI University. And since week two of school coming from hell and never coding before I started building a game from the ground up 1 feature or function at a time. I realized I suck at art so I hired a professional artist from [itch.io](http://itch.io) and I brought his art to life I will make my own sound and my own music I used my collage AI and Claude I do measurements myself the testing the debugging the design all of it myself. Anyway I would love for you to see I'm still early and it is a good time to watch me. Please check out my settings my minigames try playing with a friend this game was made with the intention of 4 player parties and was built purely for online play. Also there is voice chat in parties WHAT!!! let me have some honest feedback but I am still working on a lot of content everyday on top on infinite reading in school. [www.elusionrpg.com](http://www.elusionrpg.com) did I mention it is entirely free and you can scrape my code compliments from the chef.
